caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of fabric with a detailed, nature-inspired pattern. The background is a beige or light tan color. Prominently, two birds with patterned feathers in shades of blue, brown, and red are positioned on the lower part of the fabric, standing on the ground amidst blue and red foliage. Above and around the birds, there are large leafy branches with clusters of small flowers and broad leaves, rendered primarily in blue with red and brown accents. The upper portion of the fabric is dominated by a large tree with blue-green leaves and brownish limbs, interspersed with cream-colored flower clusters. Scattered throughout the background are smaller floral motifs in shades of blue, red, and cream. The overall composition is dense with botanical and avian elements, creating a rich tapestry-like visual effect.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
